text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many among the public eagerly awaited Mr. 
C.B.'s comeback. Expectations were also 
mounting for the up-and-coming Symboli 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, a mature Katsuragi Ace 
approaches the race with great dignity. 
Her Trainer feels just how imposing and 
dependable a presence she has become.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who is truly the strongest at middle 
distance? To prove it and make their 
presence known, they run the Takarazuka 
Kinen now!
